payload.description:
Acceptance criteria:
- CDK synthesizes development, staging, and production thin-turn stacks. Development keeps stack id ChatticusThinTurn so the live lab is development.
- Each stack publishes SSM parameters for the CloudFront URL and invoke-key secret ARN.
- exercise_thin_turn.py accepts --environment development|staging|production and resolves the front door from env vars, SSM, or CloudFormation.
- README, AGENTS.md, and infra README describe the promotion path. cdk deploy --all remains forbidden.
- Do not deploy staging or production in this slice. Do not destroy ChatticusSnapshots or ChatticusComputers.
payload.title: Name thin-turn stacks and point acceptance at them
